headline: Florida man ties screen door to his belt to stop it slamming, gets pulled into trash bin
dek: After the first gust dragged him across the porch, he shortened the cord.

headline: Florida man handcuffs himself to steering wheel to stop repossession, gets towed away with car
dek: He left the handcuff key inside his apartment.

headline: Florida man steals ATM for cash, calls 911 for a tow and leads deputies to it
dek: He waited on top of the machine so the tow driver could find it.

headline: Florida man pulls off front door with excavator, collapses porch roof and leaves house wide open
dek: The homeowner had left his keys inside and had an excavator parked in the yard.

headline: Florida man chains tow truck to his bumper to stop tow, gets both vehicles hauled away
dek: He refused to unlock the chain when a larger trailer arrived.

headline: Florida man chains steering wheel to parking meter to stop thieves, then drives off dragging meter
dek: He kept the chain on because he wanted the car protected while he drove.

headline: Florida man tests foam trap for porch thieves and seals his own front door shut
dek: He placed the package against the door to see whether the foam would mark a thief’s shoes.

headline: Florida man unbolts parking meter to fight ticket, gets arrested after bringing it to police
dek: He brought a socket wrench and a hand truck to collect his evidence.

headline: Florida man holds up mirror to hide from store camera, shows face while stealing it
dek: He believed the mirror would send the camera’s view back into its lens.

headline: Florida man pours concrete into running toilet, sends water up shower drain
dek: He left the water on to push the concrete toward the leak.

headline: Florida man drills holes to drain his kayak, then launches it and sinks it
dek: He widened two of the holes after the first test.

headline: Florida man hides underwater with orange hose, leads deputies straight to him
dek: He kept moving the hose to make his hiding place less obvious.

headline: Florida man reports stolen cocaine, asks responding officer whether this conversation is confidential
dek: He wanted a case number but asked that the case not contain his name.

headline: Florida man brings stolen speed-limit sign to court to prove road had no speed limit
dek: He arrived with a photograph of the empty pole and the sign wrapped in a beach towel.
